endpoints.purpose: Create a club. The caller becomes its Organizer.
validation: name: required, trimmed, 1–120 chars (matches clubs.name varchar(120))
organizer_id is taken from the session and never from the request body
Club row and organizer club_members row (role 'organizer') are created in one transaction
errors: 401 Unauthorized – no valid session
422 Unprocessable Entity – name missing, empty or longer than 120 chars
429 Too Many Requests – rate limit exceeded
test_cases: Signed-in user creates a club and gets 201 with organizer_id equal to their user id
A club_members row with role 'organizer' is created for the creator
organizer_id sent in the body is ignored

endpoints.purpose: Cast or change the caller's single vote in the current round.
validation: Caller must be a member of the club
proposal_id must belong to this club and to the open round
Exactly one vote per member per round; a repeat call replaces the previous vote
Vote changes are rejected after the round closes
Response contains counts only, never voter identities, until the anonymity question is decided
errors: 401 Unauthorized – no valid session
403 Forbidden – caller is not a member of the club
404 Not Found – club or proposal does not exist in this club
409 Conflict – round is closed and the vote can no longer be changed
422 Unprocessable Entity – proposal_id missing or not a uuid
429 Too Many Requests – rate limit exceeded
test_cases: First vote increments the chosen proposal's tally by 1
Changing the vote moves it: old proposal −1, new proposal +1, total unchanged
Repeating the same vote is idempotent
Vote after the round closes returns 409
Concurrent votes by the same user leave exactly one vote

endpoints.purpose: Organizer schedules a meetup with a date and place.
validation: Caller must be the club organizer
starts_at: required ISO 8601 datetime with timezone, in the future
location: required in the API, 1–500 chars (completion criteria say date and place, but the DB column is nullable; see notes)
errors: 401 Unauthorized – no valid session
403 Forbidden – caller is not the club organizer
404 Not Found – club does not exist
422 Unprocessable Entity – starts_at missing, invalid or in the past, or location missing
429 Too Many Requests – rate limit exceeded
test_cases: Organizer creates a meetup and gets 201

endpoints.purpose: Organizer generates a shareable invite link that expires after 7 days.
validation: :id must be a valid uuid of an existing club
Caller must be the organizer of the club
Expiry is fixed at 7 days and cannot be set by the client
Token must be unguessable (at least 128 bits of entropy)
errors: 401 Unauthorized – no valid session
403 Forbidden – caller is not the club organizer
404 Not Found – club does not exist
429 Too Many Requests – rate limit exceeded
test_cases: Organizer gets 201 with expires_at about 7 days from now

endpoints.purpose: Signed-in user joins a club through an invite link and receives the Member role.
validation: Token must exist and not be expired (7 days)
A user who is already a member gets their existing membership back (idempotent), not a duplicate
New membership role is always 'member'
(club_id, user_id) should be unique in club_members (assumption: needs a schema constraint)
errors: 401 Unauthorized – no valid session; the client redirects to magic-link sign-in and then retries
404 Not Found – unknown invite token
410 Gone – invite link has expired
429 Too Many Requests – rate limit exceeded
endpoints.rate_limit: 10/min per user and 30/min per IP to limit token guessing (assumption)
test_cases: Valid token adds a club_members row with role 'member'
Accepting twice returns 200 and creates no duplicate row

endpoints.purpose: Member proposes a book for the current voting round.
validation: Caller must be a member of the club (Member or Organizer)
title: required, trimmed, 1–255 chars
Proposals are only accepted while a round is open (assumption: depends on the round model, see notes)
errors: 401 Unauthorized – no valid session
403 Forbidden – caller is not a member of the club
404 Not Found – club does not exist
409 Conflict – no open voting round
422 Unprocessable Entity – title missing or longer than 255 chars
429 Too Many Requests – rate limit exceeded
test_cases: Member creates a proposal with votes = 0
Proposal while no round is open returns 409

endpoints.purpose: Member sets or updates their RSVP for a meetup.
validation: Caller must be a member of the club
Meetup must belong to the club
status must be one of yes, no, maybe
One RSVP per member per meetup; a repeat call overwrites it
RSVP is rejected after the meetup has started (assumption)

404 Not Found – meetup does not exist in this club
409 Conflict – meetup has already started

022c47ed-0777-455b-87bd-7d57a57c7f83.title: Accepted AI proposal: Generate API contracts
022c47ed-0777-455b-87bd-7d57a57c7f83.decision:
This catalog has 7 endpoints, slightly over the 'about 6' you asked for. That keeps one write endpoint per MVP completion criterion.

Sign-in is not listed: Auth.js provides its own magic-link routes.

The three existing ids were kept.
- The vote endpoint changed from POST with a 409 on repeat to PUT /api/clubs/:id/vote. A repeat call now changes the vote, because the acceptance criterion says a vote can be changed until the round closes.
- Error strings now follow the 'code – reason' format.

The approved schema is missing some tables. These need decisions, and no ids were invented for them:
1) No invites table. Endpoints reference clubs only. Use a new invites table or a signed token.
2) No votes table. book_proposals.votes cannot enforce one vote per member or vote changes. Add a votes table with a unique key on (round, user).
3) No rounds model. The 'open/closed round' rules and the 409 errors assume one.
4) No rsvps table.
5) Add a unique constraint on club_members(club_id, user_i
